description: This file defines the PhpHash class, implementing incremental hashing using PHP's hash functions. It provides methods for updating data, finalizing the hash, resetting the hash context, and managing hashing options.

classes.name: PhpHash
classes.description: Incremental hashing class implementing HashInterface, providing methods for hash computation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a PhpHash object with specified algorithm and options.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the hash with new data.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the hash computation and returns the hash value.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the hash context to start fresh.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the hash context resource.
